sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        o.ORGANIZATION_ID,
        o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
    FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%'
      AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY b.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE
        ) AS dept_rank
    FROM base b
)
SELECT
    r.ORGANIZATION_ID,
    r.dept_rank,
    h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG,
    h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h
    ON h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID;

sql_reading_B.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        o.ORGANIZATION_ID,
        h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG,
        h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
    FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h
        ON h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
    WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%'
      AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY b.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE
        ) AS dept_rank
    FROM base b
)
SELECT
    ORGANIZATION_ID,
    dept_rank,
    HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG,
    HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
FROM ranked;
